chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ali ibn Ra'ab, from Zurara ibn A'yan, who said:
I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about the Words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'And the chaste women from among those who have been Given the Book before you'
So he (peace be upon him) said: 'This is Abrogated by His Words: 'and hold not to the ties of marriage of unbelieving women''

key_terms.عِصَمِ الْكَوافِرِ: Ties of marriage of unbelieving women

ai.seo_question: How is the verse about marrying women of the Book abrogated according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Zurara bin A'yan queries Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) regarding the status of chaste women from the People of the Book mentioned in Quran 5:5. The Imam clarifies that this permission is abrogated (mansukh) by the verse in Surah Al-Mumtahanah (60:10), which commands believers not to hold to the marriage ties of disbelieving women, thereby refining the legal ruling for the Shia community. This narration highlights the Shia scholarly approach to reconciling apparent contradictions in the Quran through the mechanism of abrogation.
